snippet.title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss | Gameplay Overview
snippet.description:
What happened in the abyss?

Step into the suit of Agent Noah to explore a silent deep-sea station, manage limited energy to analyze clues, and struggle against a corruption that threatens your very reality. Enhance your suit's capabilities, manage your sanity, and forge your own path to the truth in Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss.

Pre-order now on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2760560/Cthulhu_The_Cosmic_Abyss/

The character of Key, your AI assistant, was designed to have a unique and complex personality. To achieve this, Key is brought to life by the incredible performance of a real and talented human voice actor, whose work is central to the game's atmosphere.

More about the game below
https://discord.gg/Nhz2grcx39 
https://x.com/PlayCthulhuCA
